verses.en: Now, behold, I say unto you, that because you delivered up those writings which you had power given unto you to translate by the means of the Urim and Thummim, into the hands of a wicked man, you have lost them.
verses.sm: O Lenei, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, ona ua e tuu atu i lima o se tagata amioleaga tusitusiga na tuu atu ia te oe le mana e faaliliu ai e ala i le Urima ma le Tumema, o lea ua leiloa ai ia te oe.

verses.en: And you also lost your gift at the same time, and your mind became darkened.
verses.sm: Ma sa toesea foi lau meaalofa i lea lava taimi, ma sa oo ina faapouliuligia lou mafaufau.

verses.en: Nevertheless, it is now restored unto you again; therefore see that you are faithful and continue on unto the finishing of the remainder of the work of translation as you have begun.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ua toefuatai atu nei ia te oe; o lea, vaai ia e faamaoni ma faaauau pea i le faamaeaina o le toega o le galuega o le faaliliuga e pei ona e amata mai ai.

verses.en: Do not run faster or labor more than you have strength and means provided to enable you to translate; but be diligent unto the end.
verses.sm: Aua le momo’e televave pe galue sili atu nai lo le malosi ua ia te oe ma ala ua tuu atu e mafai ai ona e faaliliu; ae ia e filiga e oo i le iuga.

verses.en: Pray always, that you may come off conqueror; yea, that you may conquer Satan, and that you may escape the hands of the servants of Satan that do uphold his work.
verses.sm: Tatalo e lē aunoa, ina ia mafai ona e sau ai o lē ua manumalo; ioe, ina ia mafai ona e manumalo ia Satani, ma ina ia e sao ese mai lima o auauna a Satani ua sapasapaia lana galuega.

verses.en: Behold, they have sought to destroy you; yea, even the man in whom you have trusted has sought to destroy you.
verses.sm: Faauta, sa latou saili e faaumatia oe; ioe, e oo lava i le tagata o lē na e faatuatuaina na saili e faaumatia oe.

verses.en: And for this cause I said that he is a wicked man, for he has sought to take away the things wherewith you have been entrusted; and he has also sought to destroy your gift.
verses.sm: Ma o le pogai lenei na Ou fai atu ai o ia o se tagata amioleaga, ona sa saili o ia e aveese mea na faatuatuaina atu ia te oe; ma sa saili foi o ia e faaumatia lau meaalofa.

verses.en: And because you have delivered the writings into his hands, behold, wicked men have taken them from you.
verses.sm: Ma ona ua e tuu atu tusitusiga i ona lima, faauta, ua ave i latou e tagata amioleaga mai ia te oe.

verses.en: Therefore, you have delivered them up, yea, that which was sacred, unto wickedness.
verses.sm: O lea, ua e tuu atu i latou, ioe, ia mea ua paia, i e amioleaga.

verses.en: And, behold, Satan hath put it into their hearts to alter the words which you have caused to be written, or which you have translated, which have gone out of your hands.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, ua tuu e Satani i o latou loto e sui upu na e faia ia tusia, po o ia na e faaliliuina, lea ua tea ese atu mai ou lima.

verses.en: And behold, I say unto you, that because they have altered the words, they read contrary from that which you translated and caused to be written;
verses.sm: Ma faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, ona ua latou suia upu, ua ese lo latou faitauina mai mea na e faaliliuina ma faia ia tusiaina;

verses.en: And, on this wise, the devil has sought to lay a cunning plan, that he may destroy this work;
verses.sm: Ma, o le ala lenei, ua saili ai le tiapolo e faataoto se fuafuaga poto, e mafai ai ona ia faaumatia lenei galuega;

verses.en: For he hath put into their hearts to do this, that by lying they may say they have caught you in the words which you have pretended to translate.
verses.sm: Ona ua ia tuu i o latou loto ia faia lenei mea, ina ia mafai, i le pepelo, ona latou fai mai ua latou maua oe i upu na e faatagā faaliliuina.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you, that I will not suffer that Satan shall accomplish his evil design in this thing.
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, Ou te lē tuu atu ia faataunuu e Satani lana fuafuaga leaga i lenei mea.

verses.en: For behold, he has put it into their hearts to get thee to tempt the Lord thy God, in asking to translate it over again.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, ua tuu e ia i o latou loto e uunai oe ia e tofotofo i le Alii lou Atua, i le ole atu lea ia toe faaliliu ia upu.

verses.en: And then, behold, they say and think in their hearts—We will see if God has given him power to translate; if so, he will also give him power again;
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, ona latou fai ane lea ma mafaufau i o latou loto— O le a tatou vaai pe na tuu mai e le Atua ia te ia le mana e faaliliu ai; afai na faapea, o le a ia toe tuu mai ia te ia le mana;

verses.en: And if God giveth him power again, or if he translates again, or, in other words, if he bringeth forth the same words, behold, we have the same with us, and we have altered them;
verses.sm: Ma afai e toe tuu mai e le Atua ia te ia le mana, pe afai e toe faaliliu o ia, po o, i ni isi upu, afai na te aumai upu lava ia e tasi, faauta, ua i ai ia te i tatou ia lava upu e tasi, ma ua tatou suia i latou;

verses.en: Therefore they will not agree, and we will say that he has lied in his words, and that he has no gift, and that he has no power;
verses.sm: O lea o le a lē tutusa i latou, ma o le a tatou fai atu ai ua pepelo o ia i ana upu, ma ua lē o ia te ia se meaalofa, ma ua lē o ia te ia se mana;

verses.en: Therefore we will destroy him, and also the work; and we will do this that we may not be ashamed in the end, and that we may get glory of the world.
verses.sm: O lea o le a tatou faaumatia ai o ia, ma le galuega foi; ma o le a tatou faia lenei mea ina ia tatou lē maasiasi i le iuga, ma ina ia tatou maua viiga a le lalolagi.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that Satan has great hold upon their hearts; he stirreth them up to iniquity against that which is good;
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, ua i ai ia Satani se uumau malosi i o latou loto; ua ia faaoso a’e i latou i le amioletonu e faasaga i mea ua lelei;

verses.en: And their hearts are corrupt, and full of wickedness and abominations; and they love darkness rather than light, because their deeds are evil; therefore they will not ask of me.
verses.sm: Ma ua eleelea o latou loto, ma tumu i le amioleaga ma mea inosia; ma ua latou fiafia i le pouliuli nai lo le malamalama, ona ua leaga a latou mea e fai; o lea latou te lē ole mai ai ia te a’u.

verses.en: Satan stirreth them up, that he may lead their souls to destruction.
verses.sm: Ua faaoso a’e i latou e Satani, ina ia mafai ona ia taitai atu o latou agaga i le faafanoga.

verses.en: And thus he has laid a cunning plan, thinking to destroy the work of God; but I will require this at their hands, and it shall turn to their shame and condemnation in the day of judgment.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona ia faataoto o se fuafuaga poto, i le manatu e faaumatia ai le galuega a le Atua; ae o le a Ou manaomia lenei mea mai o latou lima, ma o le a liliu i lo latou maasiasi ma tausalaga i le aso o le faamasinoga.

verses.en: Yea, he stirreth up their hearts to anger against this work.
verses.sm: Ioe, ua ia faaoso a’e o latou loto ia feitai e faasaga i lenei galuega.

verses.en: Yea, he saith unto them: Deceive and lie in wait to catch, that ye may destroy; behold, this is no harm. And thus he flattereth them, and telleth them that it is no sin to lie that they may catch a man in a lie, that they may destroy him.
verses.sm: Ioe, ua ia fai atu ia te i latou: Ia taufaasese ma lamalama e pu’e, ina ia mafai ona outou lepeti; faauta, ua lē o se mea e leaga lenei mea. Ma ua faapea ona ia faasee o i latou, ma fai atu ia te i latou e lē o se agasala le pepelo ina ia latou maua ai se tagata i se pepelo, ina ia mafai ona latou faaumatia o ia.

verses.en: And thus he flattereth them, and leadeth them along until he draggeth their souls down to hell; and thus he causeth them to catch themselves in their own snare.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona ia faasee o i latou, ma taitai ai i latou seia oo ina tosoina e ia o latou agaga i lalo i seoli; ma ua faapea ona ia faia ia te i latou, ia maua ai i latou lava i la latou lava mailei.

verses.en: And thus he goeth up and down, to and fro in the earth, seeking to destroy the souls of men.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona alu o ia i luga ma lalo, i lea mea ma lea mea i le lalolagi, e saili e faaumatia agaga o tagata.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, wo be unto him that lieth to deceive because he supposeth that another lieth to deceive, for such are not exempt from the justice of God.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, oi talofa ia te ia o lē e pepelo e faasese atu ai ona ua manatu o ia ua pepelo se tasi tagata e faasese mai ai, ona o tagata faapea e lē sao mai le faamasinotonu a le Atua.

verses.en: Now, behold, they have altered these words, because Satan saith unto them: He hath deceived you—and thus he flattereth them away to do iniquity, to get thee to tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.sm: O lenei, faauta, ua latou suia nei upu, ona ua fai atu Satani ia te i latou: Ua ia faaseseina outou— ma ua faapea ona ia faasee ese o i latou ia fai le amioletonu, e faaoso ai oe ia e faaosooso i le Alii lou Atua.

verses.en: Behold, I say unto you, that you shall not translate again those words which have gone forth out of your hands;
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, ia e le toe faaliliuina ia upu ua tea ese atu mai ou lima;

verses.en: For, behold, they shall not accomplish their evil designs in lying against those words. For, behold, if you should bring forth the same words they will say that you have lied and that you have pretended to translate, but that you have contradicted yourself.
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, o le a latou lē faataunuuina a latou fuafuaga leaga i le pepelo e faasaga i upu na. Aua, faauta, afai e te aumai ia lava upu e tasi, o le a latou fai mai ua e pepelo ma ua e faatagā faaliliuina, ae ua e toe tetee ia te oe lava.

verses.en: And, behold, they will publish this, and Satan will harden the hearts of the people to stir them up to anger against you, that they will not believe my words.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, o le a latou faasalalauina lenei mea, ma o le a faamaaa e Satani loto o tagata e faaoso ai i latou ia feitai faasaga mai ia te oe, o le a latou lē talitonu ai i a’u upu.

verses.en: Thus Satan thinketh to overpower your testimony in this generation, that the work may not come forth in this generation.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona manatu o Satani e faatoilalo lau molimau i lenei tupulaga, ina ia lē mafai ona agai ai i luma le galuega i lenei tupulaga.

verses.en: But behold, here is wisdom, and because I show unto you wisdom, and give you commandments concerning these things, what you shall do, show it not unto the world until you have accomplished the work of translation.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o le poto lenei, ma ona ua Ou faaali atu ia te oe le poto, ma tuu atu ia te oe poloaiga e faatatau i nei mea, le mea e tatau ona e faia, aua le faaalia atu lenei mea i le lalolagi, seia maea ona e faataunuu o le galuega o le faaliliuga.

verses.en: Marvel not that I said unto you: Here is wisdom, show it not unto the world—for I said, show it not unto the world, that you may be preserved.
verses.sm: Aua e te ofo ina ua Ou fai atu ia te oe: O le poto lenei, aua le faaalia atu lenei mea i le lalolagi— ona sa Ou fai atu, aua le faaalia atu lenei mea i le lalolagi, ina ia faasaoina ai oe.

verses.en: Behold, I do not say that you shall not show it unto the righteous;
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te lē o fai atu aua e te faaalia atu lenei mea i e ua amiotonu;

verses.en: But as you cannot always judge the righteous, or as you cannot always tell the wicked from the righteous, therefore I say unto you, hold your peace until I shall see fit to make all things known unto the world concerning the matter.
verses.sm: Ae ona e lē mafai ona e iloa i taimi uma e ua amiotonu, pe ona e lē mafai ona e iloa e ua amioleaga mai e ua amiotonu i taimi uma, o lea ua Ou fai atu ai ia te oe, ia taofi lou filemu seia Ou vaai ua tatau ai ona faailoa atu o mea uma i le lalolagi e faatatau i le mataupu.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, that an account of those things that you have written, which have gone out of your hands, is engraven upon the plates of Nephi;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o se tala o mea ia na e tusia, ia ua aveese atu mai ou lima, ua togitogia i luga o papatusi a Nifae;

verses.en: Yea, and you remember it was said in those writings that a more particular account was given of these things upon the plates of Nephi.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma e te manatua na fai mai i tusitusiga na, e i ai se tala faapitoa tele atu e uiga i ia mea, ua tuuina mai i luga o papatusi a Nifae.

verses.en: And now, because the account which is engraven upon the plates of Nephi is more particular concerning the things which, in my wisdom, I would bring to the knowledge of the people in this account—
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ona o le tala ua togitogia i luga o papatusi a Nifae ua faapitoa tele e uiga i mea ia o le a Ou aumai, e tusa ai ma lo’u poto, i le malamalama o tagata i lenei tala—

verses.en: Therefore, you shall translate the engravings which are on the plates of Nephi, down even till you come to the reign of king Benjamin, or until you come to that which you have translated, which you have retained;
verses.sm: O lea, ia e faaliliu ai togitogiga ua i ai i luga o papatusi a Nifae, i lalo seia e oo atu lava i le nofoaiga a le tupu o Peniamina, pe seia e oo atu i mea ia na e faaliliuina, ia na e taofia;

verses.en: And behold, you shall publish it as the record of Nephi; and thus I will confound those who have altered my words.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ia e lomia ia mea o se talafaamaumau a Nifae; ma o le a faapea ona Ou faafemēmēa’i ai o i latou o e ua suia a’u upu.

verses.en: I will not suffer that they shall destroy my work; yea, I will show unto them that my wisdom is greater than the cunning of the devil.
verses.sm: O le a Ou lē tuua ia latou faaumatia la’u galuega; ioe, o le a Ou faaali atu ia te i latou e sili atu lo’u poto nai lo le faitogafiti-poto o le tiapolo.

verses.en: Behold, they have only got a part, or an abridgment of the account of Nephi.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua latou maua na o se vaega, po o se otootoga o le tala a Nifae.

verses.en: Behold, there are many things engraven upon the plates of Nephi which do throw greater views upon my gospel; therefore, it is wisdom in me that you should translate this first part of the engravings of Nephi, and send forth in this work.
verses.sm: Faauta, e tele mea ua togitogia i luga o papatusi a Nifae ua tuuina mai ai ni vaaiga tetele atu e uiga i la’u talalelei; o lea, o le poto ua ia te a’u ua tatau ai ona e faaliliu o le vaega muamua lenei o togitogiga a Nifae, ma auina atu i le galuega lenei.

verses.en: And, behold, all the remainder of this work does contain all those parts of my gospel which my holy prophets, yea, and also my disciples, desired in their prayers should come forth unto this people.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, o le vaega atoa o totoe o lenei galuega o loo i ai vaega uma na o la’u talalelei na mananao i ai a’u perofeta paia, ioe, ma o’u soo foi, ia latou talosaga, ia oo mai i lenei nuu.

verses.en: And I said unto them, that it should be granted unto them according to their faith in their prayers;
verses.sm: Ma sa Ou fai atu ia te i latou, o le a tuu atu ia te i latou lena mea e tusa ma lo latou faatuatua ia latou talosaga;

verses.en: Yea, and this was their faith—that my gospel, which I gave unto them that they might preach in their days, might come unto their brethren the Lamanites, and also all that had become Lamanites because of their dissensions.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o lo latou faatuatua lenei— ia oo atu i o latou uso o sa Lamanā, ma i latou uma foi o e ua avea ma sa Lamanā ona o a latou faatuiesega, la’u talalelei lea na Ou tuu atu ia te i latou ia latou talai atu.

verses.en: Now, this is not all—their faith in their prayers was that this gospel should be made known also, if it were possible that other nations should possess this land;
verses.sm: O lenei, ua lē ona pau lea— o lo latou faatuatua ia latou talosaga o lenei, ia faailoa atu foi lenei talalelei, pe afai o le a mafai ona maua e isi atunuu lenei laueleele;

verses.en: And thus they did leave a blessing upon this land in their prayers, that whosoever should believe in this gospel in this land might have eternal life;
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona latou tuu ai o se faamanuiaga i luga o lenei laueleele ia latou talosaga, ia mafai e soo se tasi e talitonu i lenei talalelei i lenei laueleele ona maua le ola e faavavau;

verses.en: Yea, that it might be free unto all of whatsoever nation, kindred, tongue, or people they may be.
verses.sm: Ioe, ina ia saoloto tagata uma o soo se atunuu, ituaiga, gagana, po o se nuu po o ai lava i latou.

verses.en: And now, behold, according to their faith in their prayers will I bring this part of my gospel to the knowledge of my people. Behold, I do not bring it to destroy that which they have received, but to build it up.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, e tusa ma lo latou faatuatua ia latou talosaga o le a Ou aumai ai le vaega lenei o la’u talalelei i le malamalama o o’u tagata. Faauta, Ou te lē aumaia e faaumatia ai mea ua latou maua, ae e ati a’e ai i luga.

verses.en: And for this cause have I said: If this generation harden not their hearts, I will establish my church among them.
verses.sm: Ma o le pogai lenei na Ou fai atu ai: Afai e lē faamaaaina e lenei tupulaga o latou loto, o le a Ou faatuina la’u ekalesia i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: Now I do not say this to destroy my church, but I say this to build up my church;
verses.sm: O lenei ua Ou lē fai atu lenei mea e faaumatia ai la’u ekalesia, ae ua Ou fai atu lenei mea e ati a’e ai i luga la’u ekalesia;

verses.en: Therefore, whosoever belongeth to my church need not fear, for such shall inherit the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: O lea, ai se tasi ua auai i la’u ekalesia, e lē tatau ona mata’u, ona o i latou ia o le a mautofi i le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: But it is they who do not fear me, neither keep my commandments but build up churches unto themselves to get gain, yea, and all those that do wickedly and build up the kingdom of the devil—yea, verily, verily, I say unto you, that it is they that I will disturb, and cause to tremble and shake to the center.
verses.sm: Ae o i latou o e e lē matatau mai ia te a’u, pe tausi i a’u poloaiga, ae ua latou atia’e ekalesia ia te i latou lava e maua ai le ’oa, ioe, o i latou uma o e e fai amioleaga ma latou atia’e le malo o le tiapolo— ioe, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o i latou ia o le a Ou faalavelaveaina, ma faia ia tetete ma luluina e oo i le totonugalemu.

verses.en: Behold, I am Jesus Christ, the Son of God. I came unto mine own, and mine own received me not.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o Iesu Keriso, le Atalii o le Atua. Sa Ou sau i o’u lava, ae sa lē talia a’u e o’u lava.

verses.en: I am the light which shineth in darkness, and the darkness comprehendeth it not.
verses.sm: O A’u o le malamalama ua susulu i le pouliuli, ae ua lē malamalama i ai le pouliuli.

verses.en: I am he who said—Other sheep have I which are not of this fold—unto my disciples, and many there were that understood me not.
verses.sm: O A’u o lē na fai atu— i o’u soo— Ua ia te A’u isi mamoe ua lē o i ai i lenei lotoa, ma e toatele e sa i ai sa lē malamalama mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And I will show unto this people that I had other sheep, and that they were a branch of the house of Jacob;
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou faaali atu i lenei nuu sa i ai ia te a’u ni isi mamoe, ma o i latou ia o se lala o le aiga o Iakopo;

verses.en: And I will bring to light their marvelous works, which they did in my name;
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou aumai i le malamalama a latou galuega ofoofogia sa latou faia i lo’u igoa;

verses.en: Yea, and I will also bring to light my gospel which was ministered unto them, and, behold, they shall not deny that which you have received, but they shall build it up, and shall bring to light the true points of my doctrine, yea, and the only doctrine which is in me.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o le a Ou aumai foi i le malamalama la’u talalelei sa aoao atu ia te i latou, ma, faauta, o le a latou lē faafitia mea ua uma ona e maua, ae o le a latou atia’e i luga, ma o le a latou aumai i le malamalama aoaoga moni o la’u mataupu faavae, ioe, ma le mataupu faavae lea e tasi ua ia te a’u.

verses.en: And this I do that I may establish my gospel, that there may not be so much contention; yea, Satan doth stir up the hearts of the people to contention concerning the points of my doctrine; and in these things they do err, for they do wrest the scriptures and do not understand them.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te faia lenei mea ina ia mafai ona Ou faatuina o la’u talalelei, ina ia mafai ona lē i ai o ni finauga e tele; ioe, ua faaoso e Satani loto o tagata i finauga e uiga i aoaoga o la’u mataupu faavae; ma ua latou sese i ia mea, ona ua latou faauiga ese tusitusiga paia ma lē malamalama ia te i latou.

verses.en: Therefore, I will unfold unto them this great mystery;
verses.sm: O lea, o le a Ou fofola atu ai ia te i latou le mealilo tele lenei;

verses.en: For, behold, I will gather them as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, if they will not harden their hearts;
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, o le a Ou faapotopotoina i latou e pei ona ofaofatai e se matuamoa lana toloai i lalo o ona apaau, pe afai latou te lē faamaaa o latou loto;

verses.en: Yea, if they will come, they may, and partake of the waters of life freely.
verses.sm: Ioe, afai latou te fia o mai, e mafai ona latou o mai, ma taumamafa saoloto i le vai o le ola.

verses.en: Behold, this is my doctrine—whosoever repenteth and cometh unto me, the same is my church.
verses.sm: Faauta, o la’u aoaoga faavae lenei— ai se e salamo ma sau ia te a’u, o ia lava lea o la’u ekalesia.

verses.en: Whosoever declareth more or less than this, the same is not of me, but is against me; therefore he is not of my church.
verses.sm: Ai se na te folafola atu, e sili a’e pe itiiti ifo nai lo lenei, ua lē a a’u lava lea, ae ua tetee ia te a’u; o lea ua lē o ia o se o la’u ekalesia.

verses.en: And now, behold, whosoever is of my church, and endureth of my church to the end, him will I establish upon my rock, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against them.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, ai se ua auai i la’u ekalesia, ma tumau i la’u ekalesia e oo i le gataaga, o ia lea o le a Ou faatuina i luga o la’u papa, ma o le a lē mafai e faitotoa o seoli ona manumalo e faasaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: And now, remember the words of him who is the life and light of the world, your Redeemer, your Lord and your God. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ia manatua upu a ia o lē o le ola ma le malamalama o le lalolagi, o lou Togiola, o lou Alii ma lou Atua. Amene.
